verdictEs: poe.ninja para datos del mercado completo (precios, builds populares, tendencias). Exilence CE para trackear tu portfolio personal: net worth, profit por hora, valor agregado de tus stash tabs.
verdictEn: poe.ninja for full market data (prices, popular builds, trends). Exilence CE for tracking your personal portfolio: net worth, profit per hour, aggregated stash tab value.

useCases.labelEs: Consultar precios de mercado de un ítem o currency
useCases.labelEn: Look up market price of an item or currency
useCases.reasonEs: Es el estándar de la comunidad para precios agregados y tendencias por liga.
useCases.reasonEn: Community standard for aggregated prices and per-league trends.

useCases.labelEs: Trackear tu net worth y profit por hora durante una sesión
useCases.labelEn: Track your net worth and profit per hour during a session

useCases.reasonEn: Exilence CE scans your stash and calculates total value + delta over time. poe.ninja doesn't target your personal portfolio.
